messages.text: At 29c a kWh, power is the thing to watch — and the KBeast isn't on sale right now, so I'd point you at the Magic Miner 40T at $799, our best value per TH. Is this your first miner?
no, i ´ll wait fotr the beast

Fair enough — but honestly, the KBeast is off sale because there's no deal in place with the manufacturer, so there's no date to wait on. The "Notify me when live" button on that page is the only way you'll hear.

What pulled you to the KBeast over a 30–40 TH unit we can ship?
k-beast wins the duel mainly because of his better hardware quality, versatility, and noise level when tuned down.
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page

Same builder, same build quality — the KBOX (22 TH/s) is live at $800 and it's the tunable one: 22/16/10 TH presets, 330 W at the wall, down to ~13 J/TH, speed-controlled fans in a steel case.

At 29c that's about 238 kWh a month, roughly €69. Ships from the US, so 21% import VAT and duty land on delivery.

Want me to put one in a cart?

• KBox: You pay approx. $800 for 22 TH/s. This equals around $36.36 per Terahash.
• KBeast: You pay approx. $1,000 for 50 TH/s. This equals only $20.00 per Terahash.

Your math is right — but the KBeast at $20/TH isn't a price you can pay, it's off sale with no date.

The Magic Miner 40T matches it: $799 for 40 TH, so $19.98 per TH, and it's our best value per TH in the catalog. Ships Nov 14, 2026. Same VAT note — 21% on delivery.

Want that one instead of waiting?

Fair enough — the "Notify me when live" button on the KBeast page is the one to hit, that's how you'll hear if it comes back.

Before you go, one thing: what would the KBeast have to do that the KBOX at 22 TH tuned down doesn't?
